streamName.description: The object id of the VoD

streamId.description: The stream id of the VoD

creationDate.description: The creation date of the VoD

startTime.description: The start time of the VoD recording in milliseconds (UTC- Unix epoch)

fileSize.description: The size of the VoD file in bytes

filePath.description: The relative path of the VoD after app name such as streams/{vodId}.mp4

type.description: The type of the VoD, such as userVod, streamVod, uploadedVod

previewFilePath.description: The file path for the preview of the VoD

processStatus.description: The status of the VoD processing. It can be inqueue, processing, finished, failed

processStartTime.description: The start time of the VoD processing in milliseconds (UTC- Unix epoch)

processEndTime.description: The end time of the VoD processing in milliseconds
